name: LLM Council
description: A council of five advisors (Contrarian, First Principles, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor), cast from your own models, answers your question, reviews the answers anonymously, and a chairman delivers the verdict.
author: eskwisit

en.name: LLM Council
en.description: A council of five advisors (Contrarian, First Principles, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor), cast from your own models, answers your question, reviews the answers anonymously, and a chairman delivers the verdict.
en.safetyNotes: Agent tools plus a skill; no network access and no process execution. agent.prompt.inject indexes the LLM Council skill for the Skill tool. agent.tool.register adds four tools the agent calls during a council run (council_config, council_anonymize, council_tally, council_report); fs.read and fs.write are scoped to .llm-council/** in the workspace, where each run keeps its files. Beyond the host file API the plugin uses Node fs for two things: on load it copies its seven council-*.md persona sub-agents to ~/.agents/subagents (the only place PI-Desktop loads sub-agents from) and removes them on unload unless you edited them; during a run it keeps the label map and the hidden Stage 1 answers in its private data directory, pruned after 30 days. The saved cast, model exclusions and notes are plugin settings. Anonymity is best effort: a sub-agent that goes looking could still read the plugin data directory.

zh-CN.name: LLM 委员会
zh-CN.description: 由五位顾问（反对者、第一性原理思考者、扩张者、局外人、执行者）组成的委员会，从你自己的模型中选派，回答你的问题并匿名互评，最后由主席给出裁决。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 智能体工具加一个技能；不访问网络，不运行进程。agent.prompt.inject 用于为 Skill 工具索引 LLM 委员会技能。agent.tool.register 注册四个在委员会运行期间由智能体调用的工具（council_config、council_anonymize、council_tally、council_report）；fs.read 与 fs.write 仅限工作区中的 .llm-council/**，每次运行的文件都保存在那里。在宿主文件 API 之外，插件仅用 Node fs 做两件事：加载时将七个 council-*.md 角色子智能体复制到 ~/.agents/subagents（PI-Desktop 唯一加载子智能体的位置），卸载时删除它们（你修改过的除外）；运行期间将标签映射和隐藏的第一阶段回答保存在插件私有数据目录中，30 天后清理。已保存的模型分配、模型排除和备注保存在插件设置中。匿名性只是尽力而为：刻意查找的子智能体仍可能读取插件数据目录。

Beyond the host file API the plugin uses Node fs for two things: on load it copies its seven council-*.md persona sub-agents to ~/.agents/subagents (the only place PI-Desktop loads sub-agents from) and removes them on unload unless you edited them; during a run it keeps the label map and the hidden Stage 1 answers in its private data directory, pruned after 30 days. changelog: First release: five advisors answer your question, review each other anonymously, and a chairman delivers the verdict.

agentTools.name: council_config
agentTools.description: LLM Council: read or save the user's council cast (models per seat), model exclusions and notes; also reports whether the persona sub-agents are installed. Use only from the llm-council skill.

models.description: Model ids from your 'Available models for delegation' list; empty when there is none

cast.description: set: { seat: [model, fallback, …] } for every seat

exclude.description: set: glob patterns to exclude, e.g. google/*

notes.description: set: notes to keep, e.g. why a model is excluded

clear.description: set: forget the cast, exclusions and notes first

agentTools.name: council_anonymize
agentTools.description: LLM Council: shuffle the Stage 1 answers of a run into Response A, B, …, write <run>/stage2_prompt.md and hide which advisor wrote which. Use only from the llm-council skill.

models.description: Model each advisor answered on in Stage 1: { seat: model id } for contrarian, first-principles, expansionist, outsider, executor

force.description: Redo an anonymization that already ran

shuffle.description: false keeps the seat order (tests only)

agentTools.name: council_tally
agentTools.description: LLM Council: parse the Stage 2 rankings of a run, average them per advisor, write <run>/aggregate.json and the chairman prompt <run>/stage3_prompt.md. Use only from the llm-council skill.

reviewers.description: Model each advisor reviewed on in Stage 2: { seat: model id } for contrarian, first-principles, expansionist, outsider, executor

agentTools.name: council_report
agentTools.description: LLM Council: write <run>/report.md and <run>/transcript.json from the run's files. Use only from the llm-council skill.

failovers.description: Every seat that failed: { stage, seat, failed, reason, next } (next empty when the seat was dropped)

settings.title: Council cast
settings.description: Models per seat, { seat: [model, fallback, …] }. Set by the council when you confirm a cast; clear it to recast.

settings.title: Excluded models
settings.description: Glob patterns of model ids the council never casts, e.g. ["google/*"].

settings.title: Model notes
settings.description: Notes the council reads before casting, e.g. why a model is excluded.
